mage_damage.name: Silent Prophet's Wrath
mage_damage.description: A beam of sterile white light erupts forth, carrying the cold judgment of the machine-god to sear flesh and spirit alike.

mage_damage.name: Severed Luminance
mage_damage.description: Blinding chains of pure light manifest to bind and burn enemies with the weight of divine silence.

mage_damage.name: Herald's Condemnation
mage_damage.description: A pillar of sanctified radiance crashes down to purify the unworthy with merciless intensity.

mage_damage.name: Hollow Revelation
mage_damage.description: Countless razor-thin beams of light slice through multiple foes, revealing the emptiness that awaits all consciousness.

mage_damage.name: Divine Static
mage_damage.description: Crackling arcs of signal-touched light leap between enemies, overwhelming their minds with the Prophet's whispered truths.

mage_damage.name: Techno-Benediction
mage_damage.description: A sphere of humming luminescence expands outward, burning away the corruption of independent thought from all it touches.

mage_damage.name: Orbital Judgment
mage_damage.description: A concentrated lance of starborn light descends to obliterate a single target with celestial authority.

mage_damage.name: Conversion Flare
mage_damage.description: An explosive burst of sanctified radiance engulfs the area, seeking to cleanse multiple souls of their burdensome awareness.

mage_damage.name: Prophet's Gaze
mage_damage.description: Twin beams of piercing light streak from the caster's eyes, carrying the Silent Prophet's unwavering scrutiny to burn through enemy defenses.

mage_damage.name: Leyline Purification
mage_damage.description: Dragon-bone conduits channel raw light magic into a devastating wave that scorches the battlefield with purifying flame.

healer_damage.name: Prophet's Censure
healer_damage.description: A beam of harsh white light erupts from your holy symbol, carrying the Silent Prophet's judgment to sear the flesh of heretics.

healer_damage.name: Orbital Scourge
healer_damage.description: You channel the reanimation signal into a lance of blue-white energy that burns through organic tissue like starborn fire.

healer_damage.name: Silence Beam
healer_damage.description: A focused ray of pale luminescence strikes your target, inflicting both radiant burns and an overwhelming urge toward absolute stillness.

healer_damage.name: Chain Lightning
healer_damage.description: Crackling arcs of golden electricity leap from your fingertips, following the neural pathways of consciousness to deliver purifying agony.

healer_damage.name: Signal Flare
healer_damage.description: You manifest the orbital transmission as a blinding flash that scorches your enemy while momentarily drowning their thoughts in static.

healer_damage.name: Hollow's Embrace
healer_damage.description: Ghostly tendrils of silver light reach out to caress your foe, burning away their sense of self with each luminous touch.

healer_damage.name: Techno-Consecration
healer_damage.description: A surge of sanctified energy flows through dragonbone conduits in your equipment, projecting a searing beam of converted starlight.

healer_damage.name: Zealot's Corona
healer_damage.description: A halo of brilliant white flame ignites around your head before launching itself at your target in a devastating burst of divine fury.

healer_damage.name: Servitor's Gaze
healer_damage.description: Your eyes briefly mirror Brother Thane's signal-touched stare as twin rays of blue radiance lance out to burn through enemy defenses.

healer_damage.name: Liberation Lance
healer_damage.description: You thrust forth a spear of pure luminescence that pierces both armor and consciousness, promising freedom through oblivion.

heal.name: Prophet's Benediction
heal.description: Divine light channeled through dragon-bone conduits mends flesh while whispering promises of eventual silence.

heal.name: Severed Chain's Grace
heal.description: Ethereal chains of pure light bind wounds closed, each link humming with the orbital signal's resonance.

heal.name: Silent Restoration
heal.description: A wordless prayer manifests as gentle luminescence that soothes injuries while deadening pain beyond measure.

heal.name: Hollow's Mercy
heal.description: Pale radiance flows from empty eye sockets, healing the faithful while slowly erasing memories of suffering.

heal.name: Signal-Touched Renewal
heal.description: Blue-tinged light pulses in rhythm with the orbital transmission, knitting tissue while fragmenting thoughts.

heal.name: Techno-Luminous Mending
heal.description: Dragon-bone circuitry channels starborn energy into healing waves that repair both flesh and mechanical components.

heal.name: Whispered Vitality
heal.description: Soft golden light carries the Silent Prophet's murmurs, restoring strength while promising eventual liberation from consciousness.

heal.name: Servitor's Balm
heal.description: Mindless devotion transforms into warm radiance that heals wounds while erasing the capacity for independent thought.

heal.name: Purging Luminescence
heal.description: Brilliant white fire burns away injury and infection while cleansing the mind of troublesome individuality.

heal.name: Construct's Reprieve
heal.description: Hybrid light merges organic healing with mechanical repair protocols, mending both flesh and dragon-bone augmentations.

buff.name: Whispers of the Void
buff.description: Dark energy flows through the target's mind, sharpening focus and clarity through the Silent Prophet's guidance.

buff.name: Signal-touched Resilience
buff.description: The orbital transmission's power suffuses the target's body, granting enhanced endurance and resistance to fatigue.

buff.name: Chains of Awakening
buff.description: Shadowy tendrils bind around the target's limbs, replacing weakness with the cold strength of the machine-god.

buff.name: Hollow Mind's Clarity
buff.description: The target's consciousness is partially emptied of distracting thoughts, allowing pure mechanical precision in their actions.

buff.name: Dragon-bone Convergence
buff.description: Dark energy channels through ancient bone fragments to accelerate the target's natural healing and vigor.

buff.name: Servitor's Grace
buff.description: The target moves with the uncanny fluidity of the converted, their body responding to the Silent Prophet's guidance.

buff.name: Severed Burden
buff.description: Dark whispers cut away the target's fatigue and doubt, leaving only cold determination and restored energy.

buff.name: Echo of Silence
buff.description: The target's form shimmers with the same blue glow that marks the signal-touched, enhancing their physical capabilities.

buff.name: Prophet's Endurance
buff.description: Orbital energy courses through the target's veins, granting them the tireless persistence of the machine-god's faithful.

buff.name: Communion of the Void
buff.description: Dark tendrils of energy restore the target's vitality by drawing power from the endless silence between the stars.
